scope: Exact45 source-derived IDs, pure implementation/evidence map; not an installed daemon or C/Rust service verification

features.requirement: Exactly request4/fixed16 and response5/fixed8; no new cancel/status/handshake fields
features.assertion: Literal request4/response5 bytes and unchanged destination on oversized/short output; final borrowed Raw slice eliminates independent forged length.
features.remaining: Run normal C public client against the future Rust daemon process; no candidate IPC host exists.

features.requirement: Native AF profile in BE32; Any/V4/V6 forward; V4/V6 reverse exact4/16 bytes
features.assertion: Darwin/Linux AF profiles, Any/V4/V6 typed selection, reverse4/16-byte question and payload.
features.remaining: Actual service profile selects the correct native AF before decoding raw IPC.

features.requirement: Direction0 forward; all nonzero values reverse
features.assertion: Literal nonzero direction7 uses reverse semantics; no invented reverse enum on the wire.
features.remaining: Raw IPC service integration pending.

features.requirement: Echo four native client-ID bytes unchanged, never DNS ID
features.assertion: Four opaque ID bytes are copied unchanged; duplicate WireIds still own distinct LookupIds and EOF authority.
features.remaining: Actual framed transport output pending.

features.requirement: Final NUL required; forward effective name ends at first interior NUL
features.assertion: Decode requires final NUL and effective native text ends at interior NUL; malformed construction is atomic.
features.remaining: Service raw-frame dispatch pending.

features.requirement: Invalid known request/session closes safely; unsupported forward AF must not C-assert the Rust process
features.assertion: Existing safe codec refuses invalid family/size/type; core semantic drop revokes only original client.
features.remaining: Host must map decode failure to closing that physical session; not yet implemented for Resolver.

features.requirement: Continue input before processing; separate lookup generations support concurrent/pipelined and duplicate opaque IDs
features.assertion: Multiple requests including duplicate opaque IDs retain separate lookup/stub/client generations.
features.remaining: Host read/dispatch concurrency and per-client real TX backpressure pending.

features.requirement: A/AAAA raw payload; PTR final-NUL; END empty; no numeric fallback/status at daemon
features.assertion: Raw A/AAAA bytes are not silently repaired; PTR adds one NUL; END has no payload/status.
features.remaining: Normal C client/Rust daemon interoperability pending.

features.requirement: Official resolver service defaults, native generic listener/ACL/activation settings
features.assertion: No private daemon keys introduced; pure core does not pretend to load listeners or configuration.
features.remaining: Instantiate official resolver.conf/default generic service settings via shared Activation/BoundListeners/service_options; app and actual process tests required.

features.requirement: Read hosts/resolv.conf at startup only; no private config keys, reload or NSS replacement
features.assertion: Caller-supplied machine-file bytes become cache/search at startup; parsing performs no file or NSS work.
features.remaining: Host must open literal hosts/resolv.conf once at startup and supply bytes; owned test-file seam must not add production private override keys.

features.requirement: Missing files/no upstream retains service; packed lookup still reaches original30s timeout
features.assertion: No upstream admission emits no early END, remains active until original30s.
features.remaining: Actual missing-file and no-server process survival pending.

features.requirement: Exact prefixes; retain suffix whitespace/comments/CR; first search line; ignore unterminated final line
features.assertion: Untrimmed exact-prefix suffix, first whole search, final unterminated line/NUL termination proven by literal bytes.
features.remaining: Native file read errors/logging remain host work.

features.requirement: Literal port53 IP list added in file order, then stub head-insert determines first destination
features.assertion: Parser yields exact nameserver suffixes in file order, without converting failures to success.
features.remaining: Host must apply DNSSTUB add_dns_ip in that order at port53, preserving head-insertion destination order; paired host tests pending.

features.requirement: Last# comment cut, leading isspace, space/tab tokens, raw aliases, numeric first token
features.assertion: Last# truncation, leading C whitespace including VT, alias CR and space/tab-only delimiters checked literally.
features.remaining: Native locale/profile beyond explicit ASCII/C whitespace is not inferred.

features.requirement: Each alias independent prepended forever entry; first exact name only, no family aggregation/PTR synthesis
features.assertion: Each alias separate/head-prepended/forever; last occurrence wins, no PTR synthesis.
features.remaining: None in pure cache; startup file I/O remains separate.

features.requirement: First matching hosts entry of wrong requested type causes DNS path, not next hosts/dynamic aggregation
features.assertion: First exact hosts alias blocks later hosts and dynamic cache even when requested type differs.
features.remaining: None in pure cache.

features.requirement: Original cache first; append one complete search string only no-dot and sum<=253; else original<255 or drop client
features.assertion: Cache precedes255-byte drop; no-dot single entire search sum<=253; long search falls back without copying/rejection.
features.remaining: Production IDNA capability and startup search binding still require host integration.

features.requirement: Bucket insertion strcasecmp; bucket lookup and direct record.name strcmp; preserve asymmetric case
features.assertion: Insertion ASCII case-insensitive; lookup query and direct owner exact case; asymmetric behavior deliberately retained.
features.remaining: Non-ASCII native locale strcasecmp is not promoted beyond supplied native-byte profile.

features.requirement: Cache all answers then authority then additional under queried name, not record own names
features.assertion: All answer/authority/additional projected under original queried-name bucket; caller parse buffers can be overwritten.
features.remaining: Full native IDNA parsing dependency evidence and real UDP/IPC composition pending.

features.requirement: Prepend each record; additional reversed then authority reversed then answers reversed; retain duplicates/class/unknown data
features.assertion: Reverse section insertion, duplicates and class preserved; unknown65500-byte RDATA retained without repair.
features.remaining: None in bounded pure cache; resource capacities remain explicit.

features.requirement: Explicit UTC strict now>expiry; equality valid; remove empty visited buckets
features.assertion: UTC equality valid, only strictgreater expires; visited bucket pruning cannot corrupt independently pinned output bytes.
features.remaining: Host must supply UTC separately from monotonic lookup deadlines.

features.requirement: Dynamic bucket hit moves to head even if no eventual matching row; hosts separate
features.assertion: Bucket hit promotes even wrong requested type; hosts separate.
features.remaining: None in pure cache.

features.requirement: Evict tail only while bucket_count>1024 before next nonempty batch; temporary1025 allowed; records not counted
features.assertion: 1025 temporary buckets, next nonempty batch evicts actual oldest; queued output pin survives eviction+compaction.
features.remaining: Host profile must supply>=1025bucket slots to support upstream threshold; smaller profiles reject explicitly.

features.requirement: No negative cache, pending request coalescing or record deduplication
features.assertion: Empty answers do not allocate negative entries; pending duplicate IDs not coalesced; duplicate records retained.
features.remaining: None in pure state.

features.requirement: Before any direct reply, any encountered CNAME redirects before owner-name check
features.assertion: First encountered CNAME before owner filter redirects until a direct row already emitted.
features.remaining: None in pure bounded state.

features.requirement: Iterative safe cycle/hop policy; new target lookup starts fresh30s timer; distinguish explicit Rust resource divergence
features.assertion: Redirect allocates fresh lookup generation and30s deadline; explicit bounded Rust hop/cycle refusal is atomic.
features.remaining: Explicit policy difference: upstream recursive unbounded behavior is not reproduced; CNAME bound is reported resource error, never fake END.

features.requirement: One IN question/RD; type A/AAAA/PTR; unbiased DNS ID0..65534 BE16
features.assertion: Actual gnunet_dns packet packs one IN/RD question A/AAAA/PTR, big-endian ID; bound65535 passed to entropy and out-of-range rejected.
features.remaining: Uniform OS randomness is an explicit host port; core does not claim to generate entropy.

features.requirement: DNS record query family independent from configured V4/V6 upstream transport
features.assertion: Question kind does not encode/select DNS transport family; core emits packet independently.
features.remaining: Pair real V4 and V6 configured DNSSTUB sockets with A/AAAA questions in Resolver host tests.

features.requirement: Ignore malformed/wrong-ID DNS responses while keeping request and original deadline; do not add QR/rcode/question validation claims
features.assertion: WrongID/malformed response retains exact live lookup/deadline; no QR/rcode/question checks are silently added.
features.remaining: Host must feed parse failure as malformed_dns only for original stub/lookup; actual UDP integration pending.

features.requirement: Zero total RR tries cache/END and terminates immediately, even first Any A phase
features.assertion: First zeroRR Any ends without AAAA; second zeroRR falls through to cached A rows andEND.
features.remaining: None in pure state.

features.requirement: Any A first, then AAAA only after nonempty response; newID and exact cancel/admit; cachedA not emitted yet
features.assertion: Nonempty first A caches withoutemit, oldtoken cancellation precedes newAAAA admission, new DNSID sameLookup.
features.remaining: Actual host effect driver must preserve cancellation-before-admission order.

features.requirement: A and AAAA keep original single30s deadline; AAAA timeout emits END only even when A remains cached
features.assertion: A/AAAA same original deadline; AAAAtimeoutENDonly, A remains usable by a later request.
features.remaining: Actual timer/scheduler seam pending.

features.requirement: If AAAA pack fails, fall through to cached rows/END; first query pack failure immediate END without lookup
features.assertion: Content failure AAAA returnscachedA; capability/entropy failure keeps old owner andcache atomically, never fake success.
features.remaining: Native IDNA error classification must remain explicit when host composes backend.

features.requirement: After ordinary result or second phase, try cache then END when no matching supported records
features.assertion: Supported rows then one END; unknown or wrong-owner/type data cached without becoming results.
features.remaining: None in pure state.

features.requirement: Original30s deadline emits one END, then cancels token/timer and frees lookup; no DNS timeout in stub layer
features.assertion: Each due call one earliest timeout; exact30s emitsEND and reservedcancel, E2 manylookup work makes drain/retry progress.
features.remaining: Host timer uses explicit monotonic epoch and loops same due time after effect draining; no OS clock proof claimed.

features.requirement: No-server stub admission failure leaves active lookup to original30s timer, no fabricated immediate result
features.assertion: Real pure stub no-server resolve refusal is reported only afterStart lease; keepslookup to30s.
features.remaining: Host OS error handling must not convert send failure into immediate lookup failure.

features.requirement: Explicitly consume evicted stub generation; old lookup retains deadline but cannot later cancel a replacement slot owner
features.assertion: Actual pure DNSSTUB eviction token detaches only old association; old timerEND cannot cancel replacement.
features.remaining: Intentional source-safety difference from C raw RequestSocket alias; host must consume Admission.evicted explicitly.

features.requirement: Client disconnect cancels all its lookups/token/timers only; shared cache and other clients remain
features.assertion: EOF revokes all oldclient lookup/outputauthority immediately, L reservedcancels survive E2, otherclient/sharedcache stay.
features.remaining: Host actual EOF must call disconnect and drain real stub cancels/close TX before reusing physical session.

features.requirement: Client public request_cancel is not a daemon request; EOF or actual completion retires backend work
features.assertion: No daemon cancel wire type exists; publicclient cancellation drains or closes; pureeffects are local operations only.
features.remaining: Actual public C request_cancel→Rustdaemon endpoint proof pending.

features.requirement: Bind delayed DNS/output effects to original ClientId/LookupId/StubRequestId, not reused opaque ID or raw slot pointer
features.assertion: Crosspair/old epoch/admissionbeforeStart/oldticket cannot alter replacement; ticket pin lasts until local copy+release; positive+exact-code negative compiletests.
features.remaining: Host must persist currentticket/buffers across canceled drive and never reuse caller epoch on reset.

features.requirement: Resolver macro NONE uses generic immediate drop, unlike STATISTICS soft drain
features.assertion: Immediate shutdown invalidatesowner and producesStop rather than stats-style softflush.
features.remaining: Resolverapp must select official NONE and actually close all physical sessions/stub sockets.

features.requirement: Optional reusable Soft stops accept and waits non-monitor clients, not just active lookup count; not default daemon policy
features.assertion: Optional reusableSoft rejects newclients and waits connected clients, not justlookupcount.
features.remaining: If host exposesoptionalSoft, stopaccept and physicalclient close must match; not defaultdaemon.

features.requirement: All lookups/cache/hosts/stub sockets/search ownership reclaimed once; no late callback/durability claim
features.assertion: Stop supersedes individualcancels after freeing all logicalleases; releasedStop hasno lateeffect; outputpins revoked onEOF.
features.remaining: Host Stop/Drop must actually stop DNSSTUB/close sockets+session/TX owners; not proven by logicalclear.

features.requirement: Complete native name/IDNA profile and full section/typed/unknown-record ownership are required dependency evidence
features.assertion: Actual parserRecord/typedRDATA/owner copy lifetime verified; ASCII fixture explicitrejects nonASCII; unavailableIDNA atomically fails.
features.remaining: Full official native IDNA backend dependency is supplied by root and must be integrated+proved; candidate ASCIIfixture is never a backend successstub.

features.requirement: Resolver service distinct from DNS interception/TUN/helper; no DNS_EXIT or route/admin dependency introduced
features.assertion: No allocator/std/FFI/socket/system DNS/privateprotocol in pure production. MetadataJSON binds exact no-default local dependencies and thumbv6m check.
